params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by a partial, case-insensitive name match.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return only records created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return only records created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return only records updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: relationship
params.description: Filter by owner relationship. Use `owner:user_...` for owned records or `owner:none` for unowned records.

params.name: fields
params.description: Choose which public fields appear in each list record. Omit or pass a blank value for the default list fields, use `*` alone for every public detail field, or pass comma-separated names.

items.docs: Return a paginated list of Account summaries for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by `name`, `industry`, `headquarters_city`, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`. Use `fields` to choose which public Account fields appear in each record.

Create a new Account (company) record in the authenticated organization. Returns the full Account detail payload including the generated `acc_` ID. Typically followed by creating Contacts or Deals linked to this Account.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Opaque Account ID with the `account_` prefix.

items.docs: Return a single Account by its `acc_` ID with all detail fields.

params.description: Opaque Account ID with the `account_` prefix.

items.docs: Partially update an Account by ID. Only fields present in the request body are modified; omitted fields are left untouched. Pass `null` to clear nullable fields.
